title: THE AUTO RIFLE KICKS THE SCREEN A LITTLE MORE
why: His Q5: gun feel. The Auto Rifle used the flat 2.2 kick, 0.44 px, nothing you could see. It now sets 2.7: 0.66 px a round, and a held 25 round magazine climbs slowly (its 132 ms rate drains 0.185 trauma a round, 2.7 adds 0.193) but stays under 3 px.
now: The Auto Rifle now gives the screen a small kick as you fire.

edits.replacement: var GUN_SHAKE={shotgun:6.5,smg:1.9,pistol:3.6,rifle:2.7};   // v28.xx (cw-kickrifle): the Auto Rifle 2.2 to 2.7, one round 0.44 px to 0.66 px of camera kick and a held 25 round magazine (132 ms a round, trauma drains 0.185 a round, 2.7 adds 0.193) climbs slowly to under 3 px, so a burst has weight and a held mag never goes wild
